module: "Vehicles" career debug tab. Lets you add the player vehicle to the inventory, respawn it (career_modules_inventory.debugRespawnCurrentVehicle), switch to an owned vehicle (enterVehicle) or sell it (sellVehicleFromInventory).
notes: The sale happens after the display loop so the table is not modified while being iterated.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the buttons to add/respawn the current vehicle, the current inventory vehicle and the list of owned vehicles with enter and sell buttons.
